[EN] Mission Orders

Thulsa's units control the terrain near Firebase Audacity.

Kill {@LinkCreature:52#2006#cursed legion dragoons}, {@LinkCreature:52#6002#Thulsan destroyers}, and {@LinkCreature:52#1002#undead polykinds} to give the firebase troops room to maneuver.

Report to Raneria in Habere when the mission is complete.
[ES] Órdenes de misión

Las unidades de Thulsa controlan el terreno cerca de Firebase Audacity.

Mata a {@LinkCreature:52#2006#cursed legion dragoons}, {@LinkCreature:52#6002#Thulsan destroyers} y {@LinkCreature:52#1002#undead polykinds} para dar espacio de maniobra a las tropas de la base avanzada.

Reporta con Raneria en Habere cuando la misión esté completa.

[EN] Here's your reward, and the gratitude of the federation!
[ES] ¡Aquí tienes tu recompensa y la gratitud de la federación!

[EN] It looks like you haven't completed your mission yet.
[ES] Parece que aún no has completado tu misión.
